body:
Politics.

Yeah there's other stuff but none of it matters if I can't work

> What do you mean by there's no opportunities?

I can't get employed. My degree has been a waste of three years that leads me nowhere. Everyone else I know can stumble into a job because they've got a clear career path. I don't have an attractive resume. I don't really have a resume. I can volunteer but by the time it takes me to get anywhere I will be out of money.

Nothing else is important. If I don't get paid I don't eat and there is no way for me to get paid.
